title: Refund eligibility
text: Refund a settled payment charged after subscription cancellation or a verified duplicate charge. Otherwise a scoped policy exception is required. Never refund beyond the remaining balance.

title: Financial authorization
text: Refunds and replacement value up to 2500 cents can be automatic; up to 25000 cents need customer confirmation; larger amounts need human approval. Risk can raise required authority. Configured thresholds are authoritative.

title: Cancel subscription
text: Customers can cancel their own active subscription after confirmation. Already cancelled subscriptions need no further change.

title: Orders and shipping
text: Shipment status is read only. Address correction needs confirmation and is allowed before shipping. A verified missing order may be replaced once.

title: Account credits
text: Account credits need an unexpired operator policy exception scoped to this customer, target and maximum amount.
